clips.zh: 我昨天在路口遇到了一个老同事。
clips.en: I ran into an old colleague at the crossing yesterday.
notes: 遇到 yùdào: both syllables fall.
老同事 lǎo tóngshì: 老 is a third tone before a rising tone, so it only dips.

clips.zh: 请问，我怎么去图书馆？
clips.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the library?
notes: 图书馆 túshūguǎn: a rise, a high tone, then a dip.
怎么 zěnme: 么 is light and short. 怎么去 asks how to get somewhere.

clips.zh: 刚才下雨了，你带伞了吗？
clips.en: It just rained; did you bring an umbrella?
notes: 刚才 gāngcái means "a moment ago": high and flat, then rising.
带伞 dài sǎn: a fall, then a dip. The last two sounds, 了吗, are both light.

clips.zh: 我的手机没电了，只能关机。
clips.en: My phone has no battery left now, so I can only turn it off.
notes: 没电 méi diàn: a rise, then a fall.
只能 zhǐnéng: 只 is a third tone before a rising tone, so it only dips.

clips.zh: 比赛结束以后，我们一起去吃饭吧。
clips.en: After the match ends, let us go and eat together.
notes: 结束 jiéshù: a rise, then a fall.
以后 yǐhòu: 以 is low and short before the fourth tone 后. 比赛结束以后 means "after the match ends".

clips.zh: 这个问题很难，我想了半天才明白。
clips.en: This question is hard; I thought for a long time before I understood.
notes: 半天 bàntiān: a fall, then high and flat. Here it means a long time, not half a day.
才 cái sits before the verb and tells you it took longer than expected: 才明白.

clips.zh: 我的自行车被朋友借走了，我只能坐地铁。
clips.en: My bike was borrowed by a friend, so I can only take the subway.
notes: 被 bèi comes before the person who did it: 被朋友借走.
借 jiè (to borrow) falls; 街 jiē (street) is high and flat.

clips.zh: 他一边走路，一边听音乐。
clips.en: He listens to music while he walks.
notes: 一边 yìbiān: 一 is yì before the high tone 边. You hear it twice: 一边…一边….
音乐 yīnyuè: high and flat, then falling.

clips.zh: 我对中国文化很感兴趣。
clips.en: I am very interested in Chinese culture.
notes: 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù: 兴 is xìng (fourth tone) here, not xīng.
对 comes first and 感兴趣 later: 对…感兴趣 means to be interested in ….

clips.zh: 老师让我们先复习，然后再做作业。
clips.en: The teacher has us review first and then do the homework.
notes: 复习 fùxí: a fall, then a rise.
先…然后…: when you hear 先 (first), listen for 然后 (then) later.

clips.zh: 今天比昨天凉快多了。
clips.en: Today is much cooler than yesterday.
notes: 凉快 liángkuài: a rise, then a fall. 快 kuài (fast) is the same sound.
多了 duō le after an adjective means "much more": 凉快多了.

clips.zh: 他长得又高又瘦，很像他爸爸。
clips.en: He is tall and thin and looks a lot like his dad.
notes: 长 zhǎng (to grow) is a third tone; 长 cháng (long) rises. Here it is zhǎng.
像 xiàng (to look like) and 向 xiàng (towards) sound the same.

clips.zh: 他决定明年去国外留学。
clips.en: He has decided to study abroad next year.
notes: 决定 juédìng: a rise, then a fall.
留学 liúxué: both syllables rise.

clips.zh: 我妈妈担心我晚上骑车不安全。
clips.en: My mother worries that riding at night is not safe for me.
notes: 担心 dānxīn: both syllables are high and flat.
不安全 bù ānquán: 不 stays bù before the high tone 安; it changes only before a fourth tone.

clips.zh: 请把你的护照给我看看。
clips.en: Please show me your passport.
notes: 护照 hùzhào: both syllables fall.
把 bǎ puts the object first: 把护照给我看看. Listen for 把 and then the verb at the end.

clips.zh: 他刚到家，就接到了朋友的电话。
clips.en: He had only just got home when he got a call from a friend.
notes: 刚…就…: 刚 (just) and 就 (then) come as a pair.
接到 jiēdào: high and flat, then falling.

clips.zh: 学校附近新开了一家银行。
clips.en: A new bank has opened near the school.
notes: 附近 fùjìn: both syllables fall.
银行 yínháng: here 行 is háng (a business), not xíng.

clips.zh: 春天来了，公园里的花都开了。
clips.en: Spring has come, and the flowers in the park have all opened.
notes: 春天 chūntiān: both syllables are high and flat.
公园 gōngyuán: a high tone, then a rise. 里 is light in 公园里.

clips.zh: 我一直在等你，你怎么现在才来？
clips.en: I have been waiting for you all along; why do you only come now?
notes: 一直 yìzhí: 一 is yì before the rising tone 直.
才 cái here shows it is later than expected.

clips.zh: 听说下个月学校要开运动会。
clips.en: It is said that the school will hold a sports meeting next month.
notes: 听说 tīngshuō: both syllables are high and flat.
运动会 yùndònghuì: all three syllables fall.

clips.zh: 你应该多锻炼，身体才会健康。
clips.en: You should exercise more; only then will you be healthy.
notes: 应该 yīnggāi: both syllables are high and flat.
锻炼 duànliàn: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 如果你不舒服，就请假回家休息吧。
clips.en: If you do not feel well, ask for leave and go home to rest.
notes: 如果 rúguǒ starts the "if" part and 就 starts the "then" part. Listen for the pair.
请假 qǐngjià: a dip, then a fall. 请假回家 is a chain of actions: ask for leave, go home.

clips.zh: 雨越下越大，我们别出去了。
clips.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier, so let us not go out.
notes: 越 yuè is said twice, and both fall: 越下越大 means "the more it rains, the heavier".
别出去了 bié chūqu le: 别 rises, and the last two syllables are light.

clips.zh: 对不起，我迟到了，路上车太多了。
clips.en: Sorry, I am late; there were too many cars on the road.
notes: 迟到 chídào: a rise, then a fall.
对不起 duìbuqǐ: the 不 in the middle is light and short.
